parties.petitioner: M/S A.P. Electrical Equipment Corporation (now ECE INDUSTRIES LIMITED)

summary: ULC Act, 1976 - Land acquisition dispute; exemptions under s.20(1)(a), s.21(1) denied; surplus land calculation (46,538.43 sq.mts vs 45,538.43 sq.mts); notices under s.10(5), possession taken u/s 10(6); appellate authority reversed initial order; High Court set aside; appeal allowed on correctness of statutory compliance.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment setting aside acquisition set aside; State's order for possession upheld.
